name: Games of Coding
desc: Learn a programming language by making games.

resources.name: Artifacts MMO
resources.desc: Artifacts is a Sandbox MMORPG where you can use any programming language to control your characters with our API.

resources.name: Lambda Spellcrafting Academy
resources.desc: A visual programming / puzzle game where you build spells to solve puzzles. Covers introductory programming, as well as some data structures and algorithms. The language is inspired by Lisp, but the game focuses on programming fundamentals that apply to most languages.

resources.name: Codingame
resources.desc: A platform to learn and compete. Proposes a variety of multiplayer games and contests as well as optimisation challenges and solo puzzles. You can contribute your own too. Choose your language, enjoy the graphics.

resources.name: CodeCombat
resources.desc: Choose your hero and code your way through the ogre patrols, lava pits, and laser beams of Kithgard Dungeon. Level up, earn gems, and loot magic items to unlock new programming powers. Join millions of players and go from a total beginner to writing advanced multiplayer AI in Python, JavaScript, CoffeeScript, or Lua in this open-source programming game.

resources.name: Vindinium
resources.desc: Players write scripts in the programming language of their choice (optionally using one of the many starter packs) to control a 16-bit hero through HTTP requests, guiding him to collect gold, do battle with other players, and even visit the tavern.

resources.name: RealTimeBattle
resources.desc: A programming game in which robots controlled by programs are fighting each other. The goal is to destroy the enemies, using the radar to examine the environment and the cannon to shoot.

resources.name: Battlesnake
resources.desc: Join a community of developers from around the world as you compete for fame and glory in Battlesnake, a multi-player programming competition based on the classic game - snake! All you need to play is a live web server that implements the Battlesnake API and the language of your choice to begin battling to find food, avoid other Battlesnakes, and stay alive as long as possible.

resources.name: Coder One
resources.desc: Annual AI programming tournament featuring a multiplayer 'Bomberman'-like game, cash prizes, and a casted finale livestream. Create an AI player that can navigate a 2D grid world collecting power-ups and placing explosives with the goal of taking your opponent down. Submit your AI in the form of a Docker image using one of our Python or TypeScript starter kits (community-contributed starter kits are also available in Go, C++, and Rust).

resources.name: Robocode
resources.desc: The goal is to develop a robot battle tank to battle against other tanks. The robot battles are running in real-time and on-screen.

resources.name: Robot Rumble
resources.desc: A free and open source AI competition platform. Code an algorithm for a team of robots battling in 1x1 grid-based arenas, and test your skills against others on the site. Robots can move and attack in one of four directions, and the team with more robots after 100 turns wins. Supports Python and JavaScript, and comes with a desktop-based command line tool.

resources.name: Robocode
resources.desc: The goal is to develop a robot battle tank to battle against other tanks. The robot battles are running in real-time and on-screen.

resources.name: Programming Game
resources.desc: A realtime survival MMORPG played via websockets. There's a super simple in browser demo that showcases how to play.

resources.name: AdventureLand
resources.desc: Adventure Land is an experimental Indie MMORPG. Anyone can code up to 4 characters, let JavaScript do the grinding while you do something productive!

resources.name: Screeps
resources.desc: No point and clicking any longer! You write real JavaScript which controls your units autonomously. Any time, everywhere, even while you are offline.

resources.name: JavaScript Fight Club
resources.desc: The Red King and the Blue King are at war! Your JavaScript skills are needed to determine the victor: Can you code an effective AI for honor and glory?

resources.name: Elevator Saga
resources.desc: Write JavaScript directly in the browser to program an elevator, such that it reaches its efficiency goals. Start with simple "getting started" scripts, and ramp up to much more complex situations with many floors and multiple elevators.

resources.name: Untrusted
resources.desc: The game presents you with a roguelike-like playing environment and a console window with the JavaScript code generating each level. As loaded, each level is unbeatable, and most of the JavaScript is blocked from editing. The challenge is to open a path to the next level using only the limited tools left open to you.

resources.name: DeepestWorld
resources.desc: A browser MMORPG where you can code your character with JavaScript. Explore a boundless, persistent open world devoid of loading screens, where a multitude of biomes and creatures come together to form a living, breathing world.

resources.name: BitBurner
resources.desc: A programming-based idle incremental RPG where you, the player, take the role of an unknown hacker in a dark, dystopian world. The game can be played in the browser, or installed locally through Steam.

resources.name: Robocode
resources.desc: The goal is to develop a robot battle tank to battle against other tanks. The robot battles are running in real-time and on-screen.

resources.name: Embedded Security CTF
resources.desc: The purpose is to bypass a series of locks, essentially hacking them, in order to get through a series of warehouses.

resources.name: Box-256
resources.desc: Write assembly code to match a shown graphic.

resources.name: Robocode
resources.desc: The goal is to develop a robot battle tank to battle against other tanks in Java or .NET. The robot battles are running in real-time and on-screen.

resources.name: Scalatron
resources.desc: Coders pit bot programs (written in Scala) against each other. It is an educational resource for groups of programmers or individuals that want to learn more about the Scala programming language or want to hone their Scala programming skills.

resources.name: Generals IO
resources.desc: A fast-paced strategy game where you expand your land and battle with enemies over theirs. You lose when your general is taken, but capturing an opponent's general gives you control of their entire empire.

resources.name: Robo Dojo
resources.desc: You build robots that build, corrupt and destroy other robots in an attempt to eliminate all competitors.

resources.name: Corewars
resources.desc: A game of warrior vs warrior, programmed by two opponents, and placed into a virtual 'ring' to fight to the death.

resources.name: TIS-100
resources.desc: Open-ended programming game by Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem and Infinifactory, in which you rewrite corrupted code segments to repair the TIS-100 and unlock its secrets. It's the assembly language programming game you never asked for!

resources.name: Shenzhen I/O
resources.desc: You build circuits using a variety of components from different manufacturers, like microcontrollers, memory, and logic gates, and then write code in a compact and powerful assembly language where every instruction can be conditionally executed.

resources.name: MHRD
resources.desc: Hardware design game, in which you design various hardware circuits in a hardware description language. The hardware circuits you design get more complex as you go until you create a fully functional CPU design.

resources.name: Colobot
resources.desc: 3D video game where you program your bots to ride, fly, find, bring, refuel and destroy. Game is using a language called CBOT, similar to C++ and Java. Colobot offers tutorialed campaign with gradually harder tasks or you can play scenarios to challenge your skill.

resources.name: Code Games
resources.desc: Real time programming game where you compete against other players by coding the behaviour of a space ship. The programming language is easy to learn and the game is super fun. Subscribe to one of our tournaments and compete for the prize.

resources.name: Mudlet
resources.desc: Game client that allows you to play MUDs (text-only MMORPGs). You can write Lua code in Mudlet to help you play MUDs.

resources.name: CSS Diner
resources.desc: A CSS item arrangement game, teaching the concepts and use of CSS selectors and layout. You modify CSS to arrange HTML elements representing plates and bento boxes on a dining table.

resources.name: Guido van Robot
resources.desc: Programming language and free software application designed to introduce beginners to the fundamentals of programming. GvR runs on Windows, Macintosh, and GNU/Linux, in a variety of languages! It's great in both the classroom and the home as a way of introducing people to the basic concepts of programming.

resources.name: CSSBattle
resources.desc: Online CSS Code Golfing battleground. Here, players from all around the world try to visually replicate "Targets" in smallest possible CSS code and battle it out to get to the top of the leaderboard.

resources.name: The Command Line Murders
resources.desc: There's been a murder in Terminal City, and TCPD needs your help.

resources.name: SQL Murder Mystery
resources.desc: The SQL Murder Mystery is designed to be both a self-directed lesson to learn SQL concepts and commands and a fun game for experienced SQL users to solve an intriguing crime.

resources.name: S3 Game
resources.desc: You are the treasure hunter. Your task is to get as many secret codes and open as many chests as possible.

resources.name: Learn Git Branching
resources.desc: Learn Git on the web.

resources.name: Oh my Git
resources.desc: An open source game about learning Git!

resources.name: YouBrokeProd
resources.desc: Debug production incidents through an interactive terminal simulation covering disk full, DNS failures, Kubernetes crash loops, and more.
